title: Index day code 'Mart' (only on #194 'Martyr Dei'): Common of ONE martyr, not several?
prompt: The hymn index (p1219) codes #194 'Martyr Dei' (LHym 283, gregobase:8814) as day 'Mart', hour L. 'Mart' occurs on no other index row; oco_sigla.py COMMONS maps it to COM-MART-PLUR, so it collides with Æterna Christi munera (#9, PlM L, gregobase:17919) at COM-MART-PLUR LAUDS.hymn option 1. The body prints it in the Common of one martyr (TOC 'Unius martyris' from p1045; p1049 Off. lect. 'Beate martyr (LHym 281) vel pro martyre virgine: O Christe flos'): p1051 'Laudes H Martyr Dei (LHym 283) vel pro martyre virgine: O castitatis signifer (LHym 284)'. Its text is singular ('Martyr Dei qui unicum'). The sibling rows are #45 Beate martyr UnM Ol and #215 O castitatis signifer 'Virg Una mart' L.
